decideTranslation(analysis) is a pure function with SKIP_RATIO = 0.97 / CONFIRM_RATIO = 0.7: totalChars === 0 or ratio >= 0.97 => skip (reason empty / target-language, percent for display), ratio >= 0.70 => confirm with percent, otherwise translate-all; boundaries use raw ratio with >= semantics while the displayed percent is rounded
scope="non-target" keeps every target-language block byte-identical, replaces only non-target blocks and leaves order and structure unchanged

features.name: Dock Ghost Icon: Run The Local Server From The Helper Bundle
features.title: Dock Ghost Icon: Run The Local Server From The Helper Bundle
features.scope: While the packaged app was running the Dock showed a second tile with a generic black executable icon that bounced and never settled. The cause was in `electron/main.mjs`: the local Next.js server was spawned with `process.execPath`, i.e. the app bundle's own main executable, so LaunchServices read the child as a second launch of MD-Convertor and created a Foreground/APPL tile for it; the child never connects to WindowServer, so the tile bounces forever. The function throws `Desktop helper runtime is missing: <path>` when the helper is absent, which keeps the failure loud in an unsupported layout. No packaging change was needed and no new asset was added. The version moved to 0.3.2 because the release gate hard-checks the target version.
